basicInfo.name: Yuvam Bhargav
basicInfo.bio: I am a Computer Science and Data Science student passionate about AI, machine learning, and innovative digital design. With hands-on experience in full-stack development, data analysis, and VR/AR integration, I bring a unique blend of technical expertise and leadership experience from both academic and extracurricular environments.

education.degree: Bachelors of Science in Computer Science with a minor in Data Science
education.institution: Arizona State University in Tempe, Arizona
education.relevantCoursework: My relevant coursework includes Object Oriented Programming, Data Structures and Algorithms, Machine Learning and AI, and Capstone projects. These courses have provided me with a strong foundation in both theoretical concepts and practical implementation skills.
education.academicAchievements: I've been recognized on the Dean's List in Spring 2024 and previously as a Dean's Scholar in 2020, reflecting my commitment to academic excellence throughout my educational journey.

skills.programmingLanguages: I'm proficient in several programming languages including Python, Java, JavaScript, R, SQL, and HTML/CSS.
skills.technicalAreas: My technical expertise includes data analysis, VR/AR development using A-Frame and AR.js, database management, and working with OpenCV for computer vision applications.
skills.softSkills: Beyond technical abilities, I have strong leadership, financial management, and communication skills developed through my roles in student organizations and professional experiences.

experience.internships: I have completed three internships: a VR/AR Development and Data Analyst role at Futurristic (Summer 2024), a Data Scientist position at Platinum Corporation (Spring 2024), and a Data Analyst role at ELDAAS (Fall 2023). These experiences have given me practical skills in data management, VR/AR integration, and AI applications.
experience.leadershipRoles: I currently serve as the Director of Finance for the Indian Students' Association at ASU, where I secure sponsorships and manage financial strategies. I also work as a Student Mentor at ASU, supporting over 55 students with academic and personal development.
experience.professionalGrowth: Throughout my experiences, I've consistently demonstrated skills in financial analysis, event management, customer service, and team collaboration.

projects.technicalProjects: My technical projects include a Home Automation System using Arduino, a Mopping Robot for a science exhibition, and an interactive educational game for toddlers developed with JavaScript.
projects.projectDetails: Each project allowed me to apply theoretical knowledge to practical challenges. For instance, the Home Automation System integrated hardware and software components to create an efficient, user-friendly interface for controlling home devices.

achievements.awards: I am a National Olympiad Gold Medalist and have received recognition as the Most Innovative Student and for the Best Engineering Model. These achievements reflect my dedication to excellence in both academic and technical endeavors.
achievements.certifications: I hold the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, which has enhanced my knowledge of data analytics methodologies and tools.

responseTemplate.careerGoals: I aim to leverage my combined expertise in Computer Science and Data Science to develop innovative solutions in AI and machine learning. I'm particularly interested in exploring how emerging technologies can address real-world challenges across various industries.

education.coursework: During my Computer Science degree at Arizona State University, I've completed coursework in Object Oriented Programming, Data Structures and Algorithms, Machine Learning and AI, and Capstone projects. These courses have provided me with both theoretical knowledge and practical implementation skills that I've applied in my projects and internships.
education.dataScience: My Data Science minor complements my Computer Science major by providing specialized knowledge in data analysis, statistical methods, and machine learning. This interdisciplinary approach has equipped me with the tools to extract meaningful insights from complex datasets and develop data-driven solutions, which has proven particularly valuable in my internships at ELDAAS and Platinum Corporation.

technicalSkills.proficiency: I'm most proficient in Python, Java, and JavaScript. I also have strong skills in SQL for database management, R for statistical analysis, and HTML/CSS for web development. Additionally, I have experience with specialized tools like OpenCV for computer vision applications and frameworks for VR/AR development.
technicalSkills.applications: I've applied my technical skills across various contexts. For example, I used JavaScript to develop an interactive game for toddlers, leveraged my data analysis skills during my internship at ELDAAS to process survey data from over 700 responses, and utilized VR/AR technologies at Futurristic to integrate immersive experiences into different applications.

internships.futurristic: At Futurristic, I worked as a VR/AR Development and Data Analyst Intern during Summer 2024. My primary responsibilities included analyzing and managing data flow in prototype and research design, as well as integrating Augmented Reality and Virtual Reality into different applications using A-Frame and AR.js. This experience enhanced my understanding of immersive technologies and their practical applications.
internships.eldaas: During my internship at ELDAAS, I focused on analyzing data related to AI integration with electrical circuits and PCBs. I managed a large-scale survey with over 700 responses regarding opinions on AI in electrical components and contributed valuable data for the company's prototype innovations. This experience strengthened my skills in data collection, analysis, and application in a specialized technical domain.
internships.platinum: As a Data Scientist at Platinum Corporation during Spring 2024, I maintained and managed databases tracking transactions, wrote efficient SQL queries for updates, and implemented verification procedures to ensure data accuracy across all records.

experience.financeDirector: As the Director of Finance for the Indian Students' Association, I've developed partnerships with sponsors that funded our event calendar and created valuable networking opportunities for members. I implemented cost-reduction strategies that maximized resources while maintaining high-quality programming.
experience.studentGovernment: My involvement in Student Government from 2017 to 2023 significantly enhanced my leadership abilities. I learned to represent diverse student interests, manage large-scale events, and make decisions that balanced multiple perspectives—sharpening my skills in conflict resolution, public speaking, and organization.

projects.homeAutomation: I built a Home Automation System using Arduino to make daily tasks more convenient and reduce energy usage. It integrates sensors and relay modules, control algorithms, and a simple remote UI for lighting, temperature, and security.
projects.toddlerGame: I created an interactive educational game for toddlers using JavaScript, focused on cognitive skills like pattern recognition and color matching, with audio/visual feedback and user testing to ensure engagement and learning.

awards.olympiadMedal: Receiving the National Olympiad Gold Medal was a pivotal moment that validated my problem-solving under pressure and motivated me to tackle increasingly challenging projects.
awards.influence: Awards and recognitions opened doors to internships and leadership roles and reinforced my commitment to continuous learning and innovation.
